# npm packages permitted to declare an install script.
#
# One package name per line. Anything NOT listed here that wants to run a
# command on `npm install` fails the Supply Chain workflow.
#
# The signal this watches for is not "a package has an install script" — four
# legitimate ones here do — it is "a package that never had one now does".
# That is what the September 2025 npm worm did: it appended a postinstall to
# packages whose maintainers it had phished. Pinning the expected set means
# that change shows up as a build failure instead of as nothing at all.
#
# Adding a name here is a tracked edit, so it goes through review like any
# other change. Before adding one, check why the package needs to run code at
# install time and whether a prebuilt alternative exists.

# Compiles or downloads a platform-specific binary.
esbuild
pkcs11js
unrs-resolver

# Transitive dev dependency of jest (via jest-haste-map), used for watch mode.
# Falls back to compiling its native addon from source when no prebuilt binary
# matches the current platform/arch.
@parcel/watcher

# macOS file-system watcher. Optional, and only installed on darwin.
fsevents
